# Travel Globe Runtime

Local browser dependencies for the About page geographic memory globe:

- Three.js r183 (`three.module.min.js` and `three.core.min.js`), MIT License.
- D3 7.9.0 (`d3.min.js`), ISC License. This bundle includes d3-geo 3.1.1 and d3-array 3.2.4.

The files are stored locally so the globe has no runtime CDN dependency. Keep the library files, version note, and matching license files together when upgrading.
